scope: Offline read-only evidence analysis; only audit outputs written outside checkout

definitions.renderAllP95: No literal renderAllP95 field; equivalent renderer-call measurement is summary.renderSubmitMs.p95 (includes Graphics render, not full frame)

experiment.policy: fixed-step input policy, no world writes after creation; same per-weapon policy for both contracts; no repair; stage transitions through public session methods

limitations: Two sequential batches, not randomized or interleaved across versions; environmental drift is not controlled.
Same recorded Windows device, CPU, integrated Intel UHD/ANGLE renderer, Edge/Chromium version, viewport and quality; one device only.
Muted DEV browser rendering tests exclude audible BGM/SFX cost; audio lifecycle/energy checks are separate and are not an audio-on performance benchmark.
Frame P95 is postrender-to-postrender wall time, not GPU time; renderSubmitMs includes graphicsRenderMs and excludes preparation/HUD. Their P95 values must not be added.
Median of three per-run P95 values; slow-frame statistic is median of three per-run proportions, not pooled-frame percentile/proportion.

Fixed simulation work is identical but number of display frames and cosmetic Math.random particles can vary. Decorative particles are bounded and dropped at saturation; simulated projectile pool misses remain zero.
Independent behavior runs have no renderer. Trial automation is a fixed input policy with 10 completions and 8 defeats, not a human win rate or balance conclusion.
Browser coverage is 8 cases in an earlier batch and 9 in the final batch, with 3 repeated audio cases: 14 unique cases, not one 14-case run. Five early-only cases were not rerun in the final batch.
No production/browser deployment check is included in this audit.
